issues.where: both lightning bolts striking the spires across frames 7668 to 7679 (also set-A-06.png frames 7234 to 7245 and set-A-10.png frames 8090 to 8101)
issues.what: lightning bolts stay locked on the same jagged path for 12 or more consecutive frames and pulse brighter on a mechanical 4-to-5-frame cycle instead of snapping in and dying out
issues.fix: limit each strike to a brief 1-to-3-frame flash with a fast irregular decay and distinct branch geometry if it restokes

issues.where: the mountain ridge, snow slopes, storm clouds, and cave interior during peak strikes (also set-A-01.png, set-A-09.png, and set-A-10.png)
issues.what: lightning strikes emit only a local halo around the bolt and do not illuminate the surrounding ridge, clouds, or cave interior, so peak strike frames have the same scene lighting as dark frames
issues.fix: add a synchronized transient light flash from each bolt that illuminates the nearby rock faces, cloud undersides, snow, and cave mouth for the instant of the strike

issues.where: the three shaggy animals on the left side of the cave across frames 7875 to 8109 and the lone animal walking out across frames 8148 to 8304 (also set-A-10.png)
issues.what: the three herd animals on the left remain completely motionless as the camera glides past, with no breathing, head turns, or weight shifts, reading as frozen models; the lone receding animal also moves with a stiff, largely unchanged body silhouette
issues.fix: animate subtle independent idle motion (breathing, head turns, weight shifts) on the resting herd and add clear hip-and-shoulder weight transfer and stepped leg cycles to the walking animal

issues.where: the dark storm clouds and lower cloud deck across frames 7015 to 7337 (also set-A-02.png, set-A-03.png, and set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the storm clouds and horizon cloud bank are completely frozen across multi-second shots, making the sky read as a static painted backdrop
issues.fix: give the upper storm deck and lower cloud layer continuous, layered wind drift and slow internal boiling at different heights

issues.where: the purple-grey mist streamers trailing off the rock spire (also set-A-08.png, set-A-01.png, and set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the vapour plumes hold a rigid horizontal envelope and ripple like flat textured ribbons rather than shearing, billowing, and dissipating in high wind
issues.fix: replace the ribbon motion with volumetric advection so plumes detach, curl, and thin out downwind

issues.where: the spark cluster at the tip of the central spire across frames 7679 to 7777 (also set-A-01.png frames 7044 to 7103 and set-A-02.png frames 7469 to 7498)
issues.what: sparks from the strike hang around the spire tip for over a second without dispersing or falling under gravity and wind
issues.fix: drive the impact sparks with outward velocity, strong downwind drag, gravity, and a quick cooling fade

issues.where: the foreground snow, passing mist, and fallen creature across frames 7572 to 7659 (also set-A-07.png)
issues.what: once the camera slows to a stop, the scene goes still while a flat translucent grey fog blotch slides across the creature (frames 7572 and 7644) without stirring its fur or the surface snow
issues.fix: add fine wind-blown spindrift across the snow surface, subtle wind flutter in the creature's fur, and break up the foreground fog into wispy, multi-layered gusts
